# LIBRAIN web

> Web interface for LIBRAIN, a .NET multi-agent RAG system that answers questions over a scientific-paper corpus and proposes hypotheses whose every sentence is checked against the retrieved evidence.

- [Library](/library): papers in the vector store
- [Ask](/ask): citation-grounded answers
- [Discover](/discover): hypotheses with per-sentence claim validation
- [Compare](/compare): LIBRAIN against Naive-RAG and Single-LLM
- [History](/history): saved runs
